A 192-thread block (384 targets per block) tests a midpoint launch size; register use and occupancy effects are uncertain, and prior factor-two measurements were slower than baseline, so no speedup is assumed.
notes: This candidate uses no shared-memory staging, bounds-checks the second target for partial tiles, and preserves the kernel interface and per-target accumulation order. The controller should run the complete correctness suite and official timing metric; occupancy and performance are not established here.
